context: Kenji and Ren weigh a cautious release step.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: work chat; adverbs (少なくとも/おそらく/一応/それでも/といった) in natural home.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: この機能、今日入れて大丈夫ですか?
lines.en: Is it okay to add this feature today?
lines.style: cautious young colleague voice, soft warm earnest throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 一応、テストしてからにしましょう。
lines.en: Let's test it first, just in case.
lines.style: measured office man voice, soft warm guiding throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: それでも、急いだ方がいいですか?
lines.style: concerned young colleague voice, soft warm throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: おそらく、明日でも間に合いますよ。
lines.en: We'll probably still make it tomorrow.
lines.style: calm office man voice, soft warm guiding throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 少なくとも、半日は要りますね。
lines.en: It needs at least half a day.
lines.style: thoughtful young colleague voice, soft warm throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 急ぎすぎると、あまりに危ないです。
lines.en: Rushing too much is far too risky.
lines.style: measured office man voice, soft warm guiding throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: それでも、計画通りに進めたいです。
lines.en: Even so, I want to proceed as planned.
lines.style: resolved young colleague voice, soft warm throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 一応、上司にも一報を入れましょう。
lines.en: Just in case, let's notify the boss.
lines.style: warm office man voice, soft warm closing throughout
